tools.name: get_element_ri
tools.description: Get current Research Intensity (RIS) and Historical RI (HRI) for one of the 118 chemical elements, with a citation URL. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_subjects
tools.description: Resolve a free-text query (a compound, material, or research topic) to its subject_type/subject_id for use with get_subject_ri. Free with any API key. Without a key, pay per call: $0.01 in USDC on Base or Solana via x402 (send the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).

tools.name: get_subject_ri
tools.description: Get RI, RIS, HRI and paper count for one research topic/keyword/sector. Requires an Enterprise account -- call search_subjects first to resolve subject_type/subject_id. Without a key, pay per call: $0.01 in USDC on Base or Solana via x402 (send the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).

tools.name: get_subject_history
tools.description: Full yearly (or monthly) RIS/HRI history for one topic/keyword/sector. Requires an Enterprise account. Without a key, pay per call: $0.10 in USDC on Base or Solana via x402 (send the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).

tools.name: get_subject_papers
tools.description: List the top papers driving a research topic's RI -- title, DOI, venue, year, citations. This is the grounding tool: use it when asked what to READ about a topic, rather than how active it is. Requires an Enterprise account. Capped at 100 papers with no pagination. Without a key, pay per call: $0.02

tools.name: get_element_papers
tools.description: List the top papers driving an element's RI -- title, DOI, venue, year, citations. Requires an Enterprise account. Capped at 100 papers with no pagination. Without a key, pay per call: $0.02 for up to 20 papers, $0.10 for up to 100, in USDC on Base or Solana via x402 (send the payment in _meta["x402

tools.name: lab_quote
tools.description: Price a research question before buying it. Send a filter in the Lab syntax: +must -exclude "exact topic" (a OR b) wild* year:2015..2026, over element symbols or names and topic names (e.g. +Li +Co "solid electrolyte" -sulfide). Returns how many papers match, by year and by research community, the n

tools.name: lab_run
tools.description: Buy a Lab quote: pass the quote_id from lab_quote and a depth (papers_20 or papers_100) to get the top papers matching the quoted query, ranked by impact, with the curation behind each rank. Priced from the quote, less the $0.01 the quote cost. A stale or expired quote is refused before any payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_element_ri · Private data: get_element_ri, search_subjects · Public sink: search_subjects, get_subject_ri, get_subject_history, get_subject_papers, get_element_papers, lab_quote, lab_run · Destructive: lab_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_element_ri · Private data: get_element_ri, search_subjects · Public sink: search_subjects, get_subject_ri, get_subject_history, get_subject_papers, get_element_papers, lab_quote, lab_run · Destructive: lab_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
